new_activity.author: greptile-apps
new_activity.body: Profile Gateway key loses If the deployment sets HERMES_WEBUI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and a named profile sets its own Gateway URL and API_SERVER_KEY, this merge keeps both keys. _gateway_api_key() then picks the inherited HERMES_WEBUI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, not the profile's explicit key. The profile's chats send the wrong key and can fail authentication. Apply the profile's explicit key choice before falling back to either deployment key.
